name: thumbnail-slider
blurb: Carousel with thumbnail row below main image display.
description: Embla-carousel with large main slide and clickable thumbnail strip for navigation. Each slide has an associated thumbnail image for quick preview.
use_when: Product galleries or portfolios where users benefit from visual thumbnails to jump to specific images.
avoid_when: Small viewports—thumbnails need horizontal space below the main image.
a11y: Slide content is semantic images with alt text. No keyboard navigation built-in. Carousel is read-only.
